patches.title: Prioritize Open Surfaces
patches.principle: Check open surfaces like tables and shelves before opening closed containers when searching for an object.
patches.when_to_apply: When the target object is not visible and there are open surfaces still unchecked.

patches.title: Direct Immediate Placement
patches.principle: After picking up a target object, move directly to the destination and place it without any intermediate actions.
patches.when_to_apply: When you have just acquired the target object and the destination is known.
